title: Nice product.
text: Nice product.. I gave this a 4 star review for easy to use because it has 3 speeds. When you are blending coffee I use the first speed (lowest) but when you want to turn it off, you have to go through the next 2 speeds to turn it off..thus tending to raise the level of the coffee and causing it to splash out.. I tried pushing the button faster to stop it before that lol. I did like that it came in a nice box that you can easily store this and the attchements . It comes already charged and ready to use right out of the box. It also comes with a mini whipping attachment. Over all I really like this once I get more used to working with it.

product_metadata.title: X-Chef Rechargeable Milk Frother, USB Handheld Foam Maker Electric Mixer with 2 Stainless Whisks for Coffee Latte, Cappuccino or Hot Chocolate, 3 Speed, White
features: USB RECHARGEABLE: X-Chef electric milk frother has a built-in battery, which can be recharged readily with the USB cable. The cable is reversible for laptop, power bank, cellphone adapters, etc.
3 SPEEDS: There are three RPMs(4500,9000 & 13000) you can choose from the foam maker. Each mode delivers consistent power to satisfy your different frothing needs.
EASY USE&CLEAN: The speed control system features a simple circulation, off-low-medium-high-off. Two whisk heads are detachable and dishwasher safe for an easy clean-up.
2 304 STAINLESS STEEL WHISKS: With an extra ballon whisk head, this handheld milk frother not only creates smooth and fluffy cream for coffee but also can beat eggs or make hot chocolate.
Satisfying After-Sale Service for X-Chef Milk Frother. If you have any problems with it, please do not hesitate to contact us.
